lessons.title: Wisdom, Q, and agent assist are one lineage
lessons.why: Using the old name in a design review is fine. Using it as the only name in a 2026 runbook is not.
paras: Wisdom entered preview on 1 December 2020 and became generally available on 27 September 2021. On 28 November 2023 Amazon Q in Connect included that functionality and added generative answers. On 4 August 2026 the admin guide renamed Amazon Q in Connect to agent assist.
The service authorization reference still showed the wisdom prefix in September 2026. Policies and CLI commands can say wisdom or qconnect. Read the reference before you write a new policy.
points: Connect assistant associates an AI agents domain with the contact.
Self-service with the assistant was announced 1 December 2024.
Agentic self-service, including Nova Sonic for voice, was announced 30 November 2025.
Agentic CX designer was previewed 22 June 2026 and generally available 2 September 2026.
lessons.mistake: Writing a policy for a service name that the IAM reference does not use.

lessons.title: Turn on assist only where you can show the source
lessons.why: A generated sentence without a cited article is not knowledge. It is a guess in the agent's ear.
paras: You create a domain, a knowledge base, and content. Defaults are 5 assistants, 10 knowledge bases, and 5,000 content items. The Connect assistant block attaches the domain to the contact. The agent sees recommendations in the workspace.
If the content is wrong, the recommendation is wrong. Put an owner and a review date on each article.
points: Quick responses and message templates have their own quotas.
Real-time recommendations need the analytics path enabled for that contact.
Do not paste customer secrets into a knowledge article.
Test with a question the article answers and a question it does not. The second test matters more.
lessons.mistake: Enabling generative answers on an empty or stale knowledge base.

number.n: Default, not adjustable in the quota table

lessons.title: Agentic CX is a flow exit, not a magic queue
lessons.why: The application returns an exit condition. Your flow must have a branch for each one, including failure.
paras: The Agentic CX block passes context variables in and routes on the exit condition that comes back. Live Sync, the new name for Voice+, can guide a customer inside a web or mobile app. It is 0.01 USD per minute on top of the channel rate, generally available 2 September 2026, and not billed during the trial through 30 November 2026.
External Tool calls a tool behind an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore gateway. That is a different block, with a different permission story.
points: Map every exit to a queue, a message, or a failure prompt.
Pass only the attributes the bot needs.
Keep a DTMF path to a person.
Load-test the tool. The flow timeout still exists.
lessons.mistake: A single exit arrow labeled 'done' and no error port.

lessons.title: Voice ID has ended
lessons.why: On 14 October 2026 this feature is already past its end of support. Leave the blocks out.
paras: New customers stopped on 20 May 2025. Support ended on 20 May 2026. After that date the console, the admin site, the CCP, and the Voice ID resources are not available. The admin guide points at marketplace partners and at a one-time password through AWS End User Messaging SMS.
The blocks Check Voice ID and Set Voice ID still appear in the historical block list. Adding them to a new flow is a defect.
points: Do not grant voiceid IAM permissions for a new design.
If you still have a domain from before the end date, follow the guide's export and delete steps. Do not assume the data remains.
Authentication for a new design is Cognito plus Profiles, or your own Lambda check.
Say 'ended' in the migration map so nobody plans a phase around it.
lessons.mistake: Scheduling a 2026 phase called 'turn on Voice ID'.

diagram.caption: Partner biometric, or a one-time password.

flow.label: Export
flow.detail: If you still have a domain.
